rules.Q1: Simple recall from immediately preceding taught lesson; conditional assessment/project anchors must be made concrete before publication.
rules.Q2: Always an A–D MCQ with exactly one unambiguous correct answer. Demand greater than Q1 through a short trace, calculation, application or misconception. Reveal gives correct option, explanation and concise distractor feedback.
rules.Q3: Specific earlier subject learning, using varied response formats.
rules.Q4: Challenging application of earlier teaching. New scenario/data permitted; new prerequisite knowledge is not. Keep concise enough for a Do Now.

notes: All 221 planning checks have three distinct allocated lesson appearances.
74 questions explicitly pair two related checks.
MCQ recognition exposure is not proof of independent mastery.
Teacher reviews every lesson before delivery.
Content check scope is stated in each requirement; 221 is a planning decomposition, not an official OCR total.
